name: AI crawler traffic and AI answer citations on jasonzhu.ai
creator: Jason Zhu (jasonzhu.ai)

citations.method: panel_run.py cluster_ci (question-level bootstrap, 2,000 resamples, fixed seed)

how_to_cite: Zhu, J. (2026). AI crawler traffic and AI answer citations on jasonzhu.ai (version 2026-11-26) [Data set]. https://jasonzhu.ai/en/research/ai-crawlers. Licensed CC BY 4.0.

bot_type.ai_search: crawlers that build AI search indexes (OAI-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, ExaSearchBot ...)
bot_type.training: crawlers that collect model training data (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Bytespider ...)
bot_type.user_triggered: fetches an AI assistant makes while answering a user (ChatGPT-User, Claude-User ...)
bot_type.other: SEO tools, Common Crawl and user agents that look automated but are not mapped to an operator

verification.verified_in_published_ranges: request IP inside the operator's published IP ranges
verification.outside_published_ranges: operator publishes IP ranges and the request IP was outside them
verification.unverified_stale_range_list: operator publishes IP ranges, but the pipeline's copy was more than 7 days old, so the request was not checked
verification.unverified_no_published_ranges: no official IP range list is used for this crawler
verification.unverified_unmapped_bot: user agent not mapped to a known crawler

definitions.status: HTTP status classes; status_4xx is almost all 404
definitions.section: first path segment after the /zh or /en prefix; query strings removed; paths that are not on the site are grouped
definitions.day_coverage: full = all 24 UTC hours have log rows; the first day is partial because logging began that day
definitions.citations: share of valid answers that cite any jasonzhu.ai page (site_cited), the page the question targets (page_cited) or name the site in the text (named); 95% intervals by question-level bootstrap

changelog.note: First release. Crawler logs 2026-10-26 to 2026-11-25 (UTC); answer panel runs 2026-11-17 to 2026-11-23.

daily_rows: one row per UTC day and crawler in the monthly CSV files listed under downloads
